extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation focused on interactive visual artifacts.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed through a multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query generation from screenshots, followed by filtering, deduplication, prompt rewriting, checklist generation, solvability validation, and standardized execution.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Experiments, Others
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Candidates were aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters removed incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items; de-duplication used MinHash, semantic similarity over prompts/checklists/normalized DOM-CSS-JS, and screenshot perceptual hashing; flagged items were re-authored or discarded.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query was paired with a 10-dimension checklist; checklists were drafted by an LLM and then refined by humans, with a 10% manually curated seed used for calibration and few-shot references.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed anchored calibration and achieved Cohen's kappa of at least 0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Multiple engineers with extensive front-end development experience.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Different multimodal referees show minor discrepancies on complex interactive tasks, reflecting potential cognitive biases in interpreting long-horizon interaction logic and dynamic visual feedback.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark evaluates dynamic behavior using fixed-interval screenshot sequences, which may not fully capture highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions; it also focuses on single-turn final artifact generation rather than iterative agentic refinement.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifact generation, benchmarking over 30 models, and providing scalable automated assessment with diagnostics on visual fidelity, interaction correctness, and code quality.

name.evidence: Therefore, we introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.

description.evidence: To bridge this gap, we introduceArtifactsBench, a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation.

url.evidence: We opensource ArtifactsBench, including the benchmark, evaluation hamess, and baseline results at https://artifactsbenchmark.github.io

inLanguage.evidence: ArtifactsBench comprises1,825 executable queries covering nine primary topics

isLiveDataset.evidence: We opensource ArtifactsBench, including the benchmark, evaluation hamess, and baseline results

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We curate1,825tasks via a multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Sourcing & filtering.We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: Sourcing & filtering.We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness).

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: Checklist generation & calibration.Each query is paired with a10-dimensionchecklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. We LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: A10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achievesCohen’s κ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references to keep difficulty high and rubrics consistent.

rai:annotatorDemographics.evidence: We randomly selected 280 queries, along with the corresponding data from 6 models, and have them independently scored by multiple engineers with extensive front-end development experience.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Checklists are generated by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined; checklistgeneration prompts appear in Appendix Figures 15, 16, and final scoring prompts in Figure 17.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Nevertheless, minor discrepancies are observed in the fine-grained scoring of certain complex interactive tasks, reflecting potential cognitive biases in how different MLLMs interpret long-horizon interaction logic and dynamic visual feedback.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: However, for highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions (e.g., multi-step user workflows in a web application, or the nuanced physics in a game), this discrete sampling may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of the entire interactive experience.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We evaluate30+LLMs, conduct a280-instance expert study with pairwise agreement up to90.95%, and achieve94.4%ranking consistency with WebDev Arena.
